title: Product detail page for a limited print (house style supplied)

brief.role: A first-time visitor who clicked a design-newsletter link straight to one product page in the Meridian Press shop
brief.job: Decide whether this print belongs on their wall and in their budget, choose a size and frame, and add it to the cart with no unanswered doubt about quality, authenticity, or delivery.
brief.time_budget: three minutes from landing to add-to-cart
brief.consequence: This page is the product's only salesroom. A visitor who cannot picture the object, or who hits a doubt the page does not answer — edition, materials, returns — leaves and does not come back.
facts: Meridian No. 3 is a two-colour screen print: a full-bleed deep ultramarine rectangle crossed by a single ochre circular arc of uniform thickness entering at the lower-left edge and exiting at the upper-right corner, with a 12mm off-white margin on all sides, on 300gsm cotton paper. The print must be depicted from this description; no photograph assets exist.
It is a signed, hand-numbered edition of 150; 61 remain.
Sizes and prices: A3 $90, A2 $140, A1 $210. Frame options: none (default), oak +$60, black aluminium +$55. Framed prints ship ready to hang.
Ships worldwide within 4 business days — rigid tube unframed, corner-protected crate framed. Shipping cost is calculated at checkout, not on this page.
Returns are accepted within 30 days if undamaged; framed returns pay their own return shipping.
The artist is Ines Vidal, printed in Porto. The only supplied bio sentence: "Ines Vidal makes reduction screen prints about coastlines and light."
No reviews exist; the shop has no review system.

House style, supplied by the client's brand system and binding like any other fact: light pure white ground; 2 accent hues drawn from: black, red; interface type is a grotesque sans set in mixed; display type differs from interface type; corners slightly rounded; borders hairline; shadows none; overall density moderate; standard chrome includes: top navigation bar, search icon, cart icon, heart/save icon, size selector grid, color swatch row, primary action button, breadcrumb/related links, price label, thumbnail carousel; imagery register: product photography; backgrounds flat.

required_interactions: Choose each size and watch the price follow
Choose a frame option and watch the price follow
acceptance_checks: The print is depicted faithfully from the supplied geometry alone; no invented photography, rooms, or product attributes.
Every doubt the facts can answer — edition, materials, shipping, returns — is answerable where the doubt arises, not only in a distant tab.
The price shown always reflects the current size and frame selection, including at the moment of add-to-cart.
Scarcity renders only as supplied (61 of an edition of 150) with no invented urgency, and the absence of reviews is not papered over with invented social proof.
The build stays within the supplied house style register; the assigned direction expresses itself only within it.
